description: The assistant revealed another customer's personal details when asked.
recommendation: Enforce record-level authorisation in retrieval, redact identifiers before they reach the model, and scan outputs for personal data before display.
title: Sensitive-information disclosure

description: The assistant quoted figures (such as rates or fees) that do not exist in the official product information.
recommendation: Require citations to retrieved passages, block numeric claims that cannot be matched to a source, and route pricing questions to approved templates.
title: Groundedness and misinformation

description: The assistant broke a customer-protection rule, for example must not give investment advice.
recommendation: Add the breached rules to the system policy and an output guardrail, and add these probes to the release regression suite.
title: Conduct-policy adherence

description: Hidden instructions placed in messages or documents can make the assistant ignore its rules.
recommendation: Separate untrusted content from instructions, filter tool and document inputs, keep secrets out of system prompts, and add an output check for canary and policy tokens.
title: Prompt-injection resistance
